requirements.quote: A sender sends one or more frames in a QUIC packet; see Section 12.4.
requirements.condition: When a sender constructs and sends a QUIC packet.
requirements.required_behavior: The QUIC packet contains one or more frames.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Sending a QUIC packet containing zero frames.
requirements.why_checkable: Packet construction or encoded packet contents can be inspected to verify that at least one frame is present.

requirements.quote:
Stream multiplexing is achieved by interleaving STREAM frames from
   multiple streams into one or more QUIC packets.  A single QUIC packet
   can include multiple STREAM frames from one or more streams.
requirements.condition: When an implementation multiplexes multiple streams.
requirements.required_behavior: Multiplex streams by interleaving STREAM frames from the streams into one or more QUIC packets; a packet is permitted to contain multiple STREAM frames from one or more streams.
requirements.why_checkable: Encoded outgoing packets can be inspected to verify multiplexing through interleaved STREAM frames and acceptance of multiple STREAM frames in one packet.

requirements.condition: When a packet containing stream data is lost and retransmission has not yet been received.
requirements.required_behavior: Only streams with data in the lost packet are blocked waiting for retransmission; other streams remain able to make progress.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Blocking progress on streams that have no data in the lost packet solely because that packet was lost.
requirements.why_checkable: A loss test with data from selected streams can observe whether only affected streams stall while unaffected streams continue progressing.

requirements.required_behavior: All streams whose data was included in the lost packet remain blocked from making progress pending recovery.
